title: Civil Engineer (Core)
summary: Civil engineers plan, design and build roads, buildings, water systems and other infrastructure. This path suits students who like drawings, structures, site work and seeing a project go from survey to finished building.

sources.title: GATE 2027 Civil Engineering (CE) syllabus – IIT Madras
The Institution of Engineers (India) – official website

nodes.title: Drafting: plans, sections and elevations
nodes.summary: Learn to read and draw building plans, sections and elevations in a CAD tool. Autodesk gives eligible students free education access; FreeCAD is a free, open-source option.

resources.title: Autodesk Student Access to Education Downloads
Engineering Graphics and Design – NPTEL (IIT Delhi)

nodes.proof: A dimensioned plan, section and elevation of a two-room house drawn to scale in CAD.

sources.title: Autodesk Student Access to Education Downloads
Engineering Graphics and Design – NPTEL (IIT Delhi)

nodes.title: Structural analysis
nodes.summary: Learn equilibrium, determinate and indeterminate structures, deflections and influence lines. This is the base for every design subject and a large part of the GATE CE paper.
nodes.proof: Hand-solved notes for beams, frames and trusses, including at least five indeterminate problems.

nodes.title: Reinforced concrete design (IS 456)
nodes.summary: Learn limit state design of slabs, beams, columns and footings using IS 456:2000. Site and design jobs both expect you to read and check RCC drawings.
nodes.proof: A design sheet for one slab, one beam and one column with reinforcement sketches.

nodes.title: Surveying and GIS with QGIS
nodes.summary: Learn total station and GPS-based surveying, then make maps in QGIS, a free, open-source GIS tool. Survey and mapping skills are used on almost every site and in many government projects.
nodes.proof: A QGIS map of your campus or village with roads, buildings and a labelled legend, exported as a PDF.

nodes.title: Construction management, estimation and scheduling
nodes.summary: Learn estimation, scheduling (CPM/PERT), quality, safety and contracts. Site engineer and planning roles use these every day, and they are a GATE CE section.

resources.title: Principles of Construction Management – NPTEL (IIT Kanpur)

nodes.proof: A bill of quantities and a bar-chart schedule for a small building.

sources.title: Principles of Construction Management – NPTEL (IIT Kanpur)

nodes.title: Small building project, end to end
nodes.summary: Take one small building from site map to drawings, a basic RCC design check, a quantity estimate and a schedule. Put it in one report so an interviewer can see the whole process.
nodes.proof: A PDF report with the site map, plan/section drawings, design sheet, estimate and schedule.

sources.title: Principles of Construction Management – NPTEL (IIT Kanpur)

nodes.title: Join a professional body
nodes.summary: Join your college's Institution of Engineers (India) student chapter. It offers technical events and a way to meet working engineers, which helps when you look for internships.

resources.title: The Institution of Engineers (India) – official website

nodes.proof: Student membership or chapter role, and one event or talk you attended, summarised in a short note.

sources.title: The Institution of Engineers (India) – official website

nodes.title: GATE CE, PSU and state AE/AEE exams
nodes.summary: PSUs such as POWERGRID hire civil engineer trainees through GATE, and TGPSC runs state AE/AEE recruitment. Use the official syllabus and past papers, and check each notification for eligibility.

resources.title: TGPSC notifications – Telangana Public Service Commission

nodes.proof: Three full past CE papers solved under time limits, with a topic-wise error log.

sources.title: IIT Madras announces GATE 2027 dates, syllabus revision and new paper
TGPSC notifications – Telangana Public Service Commission

nodes.title: Interview and placement preparation
nodes.summary: Revise core subjects with past GATE questions, practise explaining your building project, and work on group discussion and interview skills. Be ready to read a drawing in the interview.
nodes.proof: Two mock interviews done with a senior or faculty member, and a one-page résumé listing your project and software skills.
